SELECT p.product_category, COUNT(DISTINCT v_payment_intent.payment_intent_id) AS num_pagos_validos
FROM v_payment_intent v
JOIN fact_order_line f ON v.payment_intent_id = f.payment_intent_id
WHERE v.eventually_approved = true AND v.is_test = false
GROUP BY p.product_category
ORDER BY num_pagos_validos DESC
question: dame el número de pagos válidos de cada categoría de producto, ordenado de más a menos
